description: Governor's Office - North Western Province - T. S. Vitharana the Mayor of the Municipal Council Kurunegala has resigned from his Office w.e.f. 31.12.2022, The Powers, activities execution of Performance of the Position of the Mayor shall be entrusted to the Deputy Mayor Since the Post of Mayor of Kurunegala Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically names an individual (Thushara Sanjeewa Vitharana) and announces his deemed resignation from the position of Mayor of Kurunegala Municipal Council. It also mentions the transfer of mayoral powers to the Deputy Mayor. The content focuses on personnel changes (resignation and temporary reassignment of duties) without detailing portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
